description: Defines a singleton class 'CronJobsStore' that manages cron jobs, including fetching, updating, removing, and handling gateway events related to cron jobs. It also manages scheduling of refresh tasks and maintains internal state for the cron jobs and their logs.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing cron jobs, their states, and related events, including scheduling refreshes and processing gateway push notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for gateway events and begins periodic polling for cron jobs, unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing tasks related to polling and event handling.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of cron jobs and status from the gateway, updating internal state.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Fetches recent run entries for a given job ID.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specific cron job, with option to force run.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a specific cron job by ID and refreshes the job list.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Adds or updates a cron job based on provided ID and payload.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway push notifications related to cron events or sequence gaps.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Processes specific cron events received via gateway push notifications.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of the cron jobs list.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of cron run entries for a specific job.
